Kernel PCA (hand-written and with `MultivariateStats`), UMAP and t-SNE on
the HELIX pregnancy exposures. The chemical-level embeddings are coloured by
exposure family, the subject-level ones by cohort.

Source: `EnvBRAN/dim_reduction.jl`.

```{julia}
using ExposomicsJulia
using DataFrames, Statistics, LinearAlgebra, Plots, Distances, Random
using MultivariateStats, UMAP, TSne
using CSV
DATA = joinpath(pkgdir(ExposomicsJulia), ".data")
```

The HELIX tables were read from the public `envbran` bucket; the code
reads the local copies in `.data/helix/*.tsv`. The bucket is no longer public, so the
chunks that need these tables are not evaluated (`eval: false`).

```{julia}
#| eval: false
codebook = CSV.read(joinpath(DATA, "helix", "codebook.tsv"), DataFrame; delim = '\t');
exposure = CSV.read(joinpath(DATA, "helix", "covariates.tsv"), DataFrame; delim = '\t');

exposure_list = filter([:period, :var_type, :domain, :variable_name] => (x, y, z, k) ->
                           x == "Pregnancy" && y == "numeric" && z != "Covariates" &&
                           z != "Phenotype" && !contains(k, "sum"),
                       codebook)

color_chemicals = group_codes(exposure_list.family);   # one colour per exposure family
environmental = exposure[:, exposure_list.variable_name];
cohort = string.(exposure.h_cohort);
```

## Kernel PCA by hand (toy example)

Two concentric circles (the original used `SyntheticDatasets.make_circles`,
which needs Python/scikit-learn; replaced by an equivalent generator).

```{julia}
function make_circles(n; noise = 0.1, factor = 0.2, rng = MersenneTwister(123))
    θ = 2π .* rand(rng, n)
    lab = rand(rng, Bool, n)
    rad = ifelse.(lab, factor, 1.0)
    X = hcat(rad .* cos.(θ), rad .* sin.(θ)) .+ noise .* randn(rng, n, 2)
    return X, lab
end
Xc, labc = make_circles(1000)
scatter(Xc[:, 1], Xc[:, 2], color = ifelse.(labc, "aqua", "coral2"), size = (400, 300), label = "")
```

```{julia}
"""Gaussian-kernel PCA of the rows of `X` (observations × features)."""
function kernel_pca(X; g = 0.01)
    K1 = exp.(-g .* pairwise(SqEuclidean(), X, dims = 1))
    N = size(X, 1)
    one_n = ones(N, N) / N
    Kp = Symmetric(K1 - one_n * K1 - K1 * one_n + one_n * K1 * one_n)   # recentre K
    vals, vecs = eigen(Kp)
    vals, vecs = reverse(vals), reverse(vecs, dims = 2)
    vals[vals .< 0] .= 0
    return Diagonal(sqrt.(vals)) * vecs'                                   # "amplitudes"
end

amp_c = kernel_pca(Xc; g = 15)
scatter(amp_c[1, :], amp_c[2, :], color = ifelse.(labc, "aqua", "coral2"), size = (400, 300), label = "")
```

## Kernel PCA of the exposures

Chemicals as observations (coloured by family):

```{julia}
#| eval: false
X = Matrix{Float64}(environmental)            # subjects × exposures
amplitudes = kernel_pca(permutedims(X); g = 0.01)
scatter(amplitudes[1, :], amplitudes[2, :], color = color_chemicals, size = (400, 300), label = "")
```

Subjects as observations (coloured by cohort) with `MultivariateStats`:

```{julia}
#| eval: false
M = fit(KernelPCA, permutedims(rescale(X)); kernel = (x, y) -> exp(-15 * norm(x - y)^2),
        maxoutdim = 2, inverse = true)
Yte = MultivariateStats.predict(M, permutedims(rescale(X)))
scatter_embedding(Yte; groups = cohort)
```

## UMAP and t-SNE of the chemicals

```{julia}
#| eval: false
embedding = UMAP.fit(X).embedding                  # columns (= exposures) are the points
Y = tsne(permutedims(rescale(X)), 2, 50, 10000, 5.0)
p = scatter(Y[:, 1], Y[:, 2], color = color_chemicals, xlabel = "Component 1",
            ylabel = "Component 2", label = "", title = "T-SNE")
q = scatter(embedding[1, :], embedding[2, :], color = color_chemicals, xlabel = "Component 1",
            ylabel = "Component 2", label = "", title = "UMAP")
plot(p, q, layout = (1, 2), legend = false, size = (850, 300))
```
